raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Ericsson
Automation Architect	May 2025 – Present
Collaborate directly with the customer to gather technical requirements, draft Method of Procedure (MOP) documents, and prepare High-Level Designs (HLD) and workflow specifications for automation solutions.
Design and develop end-to-end automation tools using Java, Spring Boot, along with functional UI layers built using HTML and JavaScript.
Designed and implemented a Spring Boot–driven automation workflow that accepts CSV uploads via UI, extracts and persists data to the database, executes remote SSH commands, parses log outputs into JSON, merges datasets, and automatically delivers reports via email — enhancing process efficiency and visibility.
Designed modular Spring Boot service classes (e.g., EmailService, SSHService, SQLExecutor) to promote code reusability, simplify workflow logic, and enable faster development across automation use cases.
Technology: Java, Spring Boot, Multithreading, REST APIs, HTML, JavaScript, SSH Automation, JSON Parsing, Email Services
Samsung Research Institute – Noida
Lead Software Engineer	May 2023 – May 2025
Led backend development of the Knox Manage Website, a large-scale application built with Spring Boot, Java, and Microservices architecture, focusing on Redis caching with indexing and TTL policies, and RESTful API optimization for real-time operations.
Technology: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Hibernate, Docker, Redis, RESTful APIs.
Software Engineer	September 2019 – April 2023
Engineered and optimized Knox APIs in Java, delivering scalable solutions for 2M+ B2B devices globally by implementing new features, resolving critical issues, and enhancing system performance with advanced concurrency and multithreading techniques to enhance system performance and reliability.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, compliant solutions for high-profile clients, including the Indian Government, Haryana Education Department, US Army, and Ministry of Education Egypt.
Technology: Java, Knox APIs, Concurrency, Multithreading, JUnit, Mockito.
Tata Consultancy Services
Assistant System Engineer Trainee	November 2018 – September 2019
Developed the backend of a test online shopping application during training, utilizing Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and RESTful APIs. Designed and implemented key features, including user authentication, product catalog management, and order processing workflows, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
Technology: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, RESTful APIs.
Culture Champion (SCI Champ) at Samsung (2020-2024)
Group Representative (GR) during my training days at ILP in TCS.
